北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京风干物燥，体感有点冷，注意多喝水，适时添衣哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is dry and feels chilly. Stay hydrated and dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪有霾风力大，体感稍凉。外出戴口罩，注意保暖防风！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is hazy and windy. Wear a mask and stay warm from the wind!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海有霾湿度高，体感微凉。记得戴口罩，早晚添衣哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is hazy and humid, feeling cool. Wear a mask and add layers!
上海.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光正好，气温舒适。记得防晒，开心地度过一天吧！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and pleasant. Don't forget sunscreen, enjoy your day!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阳光明媚，温暖宜人。紫外线强，注意防晒和补水哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is bright and warm. UV is strong, mind sunscreen and hydration!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州风力5级，体感偏冷。有霾记得戴口罩，注意防风保暖！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is windy and feels cold. Hazy, wear a mask, keep warm from wind!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天微凉，体感有点冷。风不小，注意防风别着凉！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and cool. It's windy, mind the wind and don't catch a cold!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感微凉。记得添衣，小心别着凉了哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and cool. Remember to add layers, don't catch a cold!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉风力5级，体感很冷。有霾戴口罩，注意防风保暖！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is windy and feels very cold. Hazy, wear a mask, keep warm from wind!
武汉.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 5级

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云干燥，体感有点冷。多喝水，注意保暖防感冒！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and dry, feeling cool. Drink water and stay warm to avoid colds!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆雾气浓重，湿度很高。出行注意安全，保持好心情！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is very foggy and humid. Travel safely and stay cheerful!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨天晴，户外体感非常冷。出门务必做好全方位保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny but feels very cold. Be sure to dress extremely warmly outside!
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -17℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳天晴但体感很冷。风大干燥，多喝热水，注意保暖！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny but feels very cold. Windy and dry, drink hot water, stay warm!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感有点凉。风不小，记得加件外套哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and feels a bit cool. It's windy, remember to add a jacket!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门雾气蒙蒙，体感舒适。出行注意安全，保持好心情！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is foggy and feels comfortable. Travel safely and stay cheerful!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛风力6级，体感非常冷。风大，务必多穿衣防寒！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is very windy and feels extremely cold. Dress warmly to protect from wind!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴天体感冷，注意保暖。天干物燥，多喝水润润喉！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and feels cold, keep warm. Dry weather, drink water to moisten throat!
